input.claim_summary: Pat Morgan, POL-1003, was rear-ended on Route 9 yesterday at ~8:15am at a red light by another vehicle traveling ~35 mph without braking. Policyholder's vehicle is totaled (trunk crushed into back seat), and policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Police report filed with other driver's insurance information; $750 deductible applies, $100k policy limit.
